subject: Top Story
compositeReason: No dimension is fully scored. R1.1, A2.1, G3.1, G3.2 and O4.1 stay null, so R, A, G and O are incomplete. Equal-weight composite is not calculated.

method.rule: Top Channel article URLs under /2026/MM/ whose headline names Top Story as that broadcast and quotes the host or a guest. Per month, take the earliest such article. If another article that month is a different topic class and the sample is under 12, add the earliest of that class. Exclude pieces that are not an episode write-up.
method.augustGap: August 2026 had no Top Story episode write-up in this search. The 5 August page is a UET Cast career interview. The 27 August page is an Instagram statement. Both are identity evidence, not episodes.
method.codingLimit: Text only. No video was watched. Anchor text is the body_excerpt of each indicator in data/maragonIndicators.ts. Those anchors were not edited.
